verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents the building blocks of this story as its own features. `pulumi preview` gives a no-change plan step, and agents can preview and deploy. Pulumi ESC acts as an OIDC provider issuing short-lived cloud credentials. Pulumi Policies define guardrails in code, with violations surfaced in pull request comments and checks. Neo and the homepage claim enterprise controls that keep agents from going 'off the rails', but no evidence describes an explicit human approval gate that blocks an agent's apply. Missing for 10: documented approval/review gates that block agent-initiated applies, guidance on least-privilege scoping of agent credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent guardrails.
